summary_en: Power Solutions will acquire an additional 98 shares of its consolidated subsidiary With Tech Corporation, increasing ownership from 51.0% to 100%. The acquisition price is undisclosed due to confidentiality agreements; the shares will be transferred on November 16, 2026. The transaction is expected to have minimal impact on FY2026 consolidated earnings as With Tech is already a consolidated subsidiary.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Additional Shares of Consolidated Subsidiary for Full Subsidiary Status
translation_en_brief:
Power Solutions resolved on November 13, 2026, to acquire an additional 98 shares of With Tech Corporation, raising its ownership stake from 51.0% to 100%. Prior to this transaction, Power Solutions held 102 shares (51.0% voting interest) of the 200 outstanding shares; upon completion of the acquisition scheduled for November 16, 2026, it will hold all 200 shares. The acquisition price is not disclosed due to confidentiality obligations between the company and the selling shareholders, who are the company's representative director and one other individual. The company states that the acquisition price was determined through a fair process following negotiations with independent counterparties and reflects the enterprise value of the target.

With Tech was established in July 2005 and specializes in system development, website creation, cloud infrastructure construction and maintenance, system operations and support, and e-commerce services, primarily serving financial institutions. The subsidiary is recognized for strong customer relationships and has assembled a skilled engineering team. In March 2025, it was certified as a Health Management Excellence Corporation for SMEs by Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, reflecting its commitment to employee wellbeing.

Power Solutions states that the additional acquisition aims to enhance group operational efficiency, accelerate decision-making, and increase enterprise value. Since With Tech is already consolidated into Power Solutions' financial statements, the transaction is expected to have minimal impact on the parent company's consolidated results for the fiscal year ending December 2026. The disclosure is made on a voluntary basis and does not meet the Tokyo Stock Exchange's mandatory disclosure criteria.
